title: Single-name move screen 2026-11-03 (router-gated, BigQuery down)
body_md:
Router-gated single-name screen for 2026-11-03 (prior session 2026-11-02). Layer-1 rail: >=5% close-to-close and market cap >=$2B, discovered from Nasdaq quote/info closes dated 2026-11-03 across 2,117 measured names; 146 names cleared it. 49 were IBKR-confirmed, judged and passed; STVN (-28.57%) is the one rejected_notable item because its release time cannot be resolved from EDGAR (6-Ks stamped after the close).

Passed (IBKR regular-session closes 11-02 to 11-03): GPK +21.22% (Q3 earnings; pre-open; conv 75; 1 prior >=5%); XMTR +16.55% (Q3 earnings; pre-open; conv 30; 3 prior >=5%); BETA +16.00% (Q3 earnings; pre-open; conv 75; 1 prior >=5%); DT -14.69% (Q3 earnings plus new $1B buyback authorization; pre-open; conv 60; 1 prior >=5%); CVI -13.09% (Q3 earnings plus a $4.2B cash acquisition of Marathon Petroleum refinery assets (CVI is the acquirer, not a target); fields.legacy_rule: move >= 5% close-to-close (Strategy B frozen Entry criterion 1; mechanical record-only benchmark; legacy_rule_pass=true on every item here)
fields.selection_rule: Symbol list and marketCap from the key-less Nasdaq screener (its pctchange lags and was not used): 2,120 listed names with marketCap >= $2B; the 383 screener rows with no marketCap were not measured. Moves found from per-symbol Nasdaq quote/info regular-session closes dated 'Closed at Nov 3, 2026' (discovery only). Names with >=5% on that basis (non-common warrants/preferreds CORZZ, SLNHP, RVMDW excluded) were labelled from the key-less Nasdaq earnings calendar (schedule only) and one scripted EDGAR data.sec.gov/submissions batch (form, items, acceptanceDateTime); no Tavily, web_search, WebFetch or FMP call was made. Layer 2 then measured on IBKR regular-session daily bars (close array, ONE_DAY, outside_rth=false, 16 bars) every name with an own-event release on the reaction session (49 names); the IBKR search_contracts limit (30 requests/minute) was handled by pacing. Seven near-floor names whose Nasdaq close sat just under 5% were also IBKR-checked and dropped as below 5% on IBKR closes: TSEM +4.98%, ENS +4.99%, EFXT +4.99%, RMBS +4.96%, SFM -4.96%, APO -4.94%, LBTYA +4.93%. Source limit: free primary sources only (router-gated), so a name with no own filing is ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. prior_qualifying_* counts other >=5% IBKR close-to-close sessions in the 10 sessions before the reaction session (2026-10-20 to 2026-11-02).

rejected_legend.ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED: No own-event EDGAR filing (8-K items 1.01/2.02/4.02/7.01/8.01 or 6-K) was accepted for the name between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-03, so no release time exists and the anchor is UNRESOLVED; it stays in this row only with no watchlist action. Closes are Nasdaq quote/info regular-session closes (discovery basis, not IBKR): prior_close is the 2026-11-02 close and event_close the 2026-11-03 close.
rejected_legend.DAY2_EVENT_PRIOR: The name's own event filing (8-K/6-K) was accepted before the 2026-11-02 close, so 2026-11-03 is a second-or-later-day move; the tuple's qualifying_event_date is the date of that filing (CDLR: 2026-11-02 exchange-offer final results). Closes are Nasdaq quote/info discovery closes (2026-11-02 and 2026-11-03), not IBKR.
rejected_legend.POST_MOVE_EVENT: The only own-event filing for the name was accepted after the 2026-11-03 close (21:00Z or later), so the release cannot explain the 11-03 move; qualifying_event_date is the filing date. Closes are Nasdaq quote/info discovery closes, not IBKR.
